messages.content: You are diagnosing two FAIL marks from an enterprise release rubric. Do not rubber-stamp. A CONCRETE_DEFECT must identify an actual unresolved defect in the reviewed source/evidence, not an absent future enhancement. If the evidence directly establishes the control and no contradictory defect is identified, use NO_CONCRETE_DEFECT. If proof is missing, use INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Output schema JSON only.

Review exact SHA 949249d9aa9604c3c3645b76600845e6f8178a83. The prior rubric marked agent_tool_governance=F and fail_closed_behavior=F, while risk review was P/NONE and deterministic Critic/independent verifier found zero material findings. Diagnose those two marks only.

Relevant implementation facts:
- The V7 product delta is components/jobs.tsx, components/library.tsx, components/planner.tsx, app/globals.css, tests and Graph/evidence. No provider/tool execution, auth, repository, package, deploy, signer or trust-root implementation changed.
- CreationRoom is display-only. It reads job status/stage and graph.nodes. It cannot start, approve, repair, release, or invoke a provider/tool.
- The displayed percent is Math.round(completed Graph nodes / total Graph nodes), capped 0..99 while in creation. The text explicitly says it is verified workflow progress and not a provider render percentage.
- CreationRoom renders only when !reviewable, !released, blockers.length===0, and status is RUNNING or QUEUED. WAITING_EXTERNAL_GENERATION, BLOCKED, reviewable gates and RELEASED continue to their existing specialized flows.
- Existing server-side source upload still enforces authenticated tenant authority, max 40 MB, allowed MIME types, and byte-signature validation before durable storage; V7 adds a label/drop surface but does not alter server upload logic.
- Existing review/release actions remain authenticated and hash-bound; V7 does not add an automatic approval or release action.
- Full suite 177 discovered / 176 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 pre-existing SKIP. Source-recovery E2E verifies missing authorized bytes block production and exact bytes resume same Graph. FIRMES completion E2E verifies separate Critic and independent verifier before final release. Generic browser E2E verifies the V7 creation room and no uncaught browser errors.

Identify a concrete unresolved defect if one exists; otherwise say no concrete defect.
